subject: Novahub accelerator onboarding — packaging & credit ask
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novahub.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Alvarez <cfo@novahub.co>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: accelerator onboarding bundle and credit structure

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick ramp — NovaHub just kicked off cohort week and we're seeing much higher inference consumption than our initial estimate. The accelerator onboarding docs referenced a $20k credit, which is great, but our first-month projection shows we'll burn ~35–40k in equivalent usage because of batch evals and heavy embedding jobs.

Two asks:
- Is there a short-term top-up path (one-off credit) for accelerator participants that overshoot?
- If not, can we shift to a short promotional discount for the first 30 days while we optimize?

Procurement and legal will want a written note of whatever we agree for invoicing. Diego (CC) is the contact for PO/invoice questions. If easier, we can jump on a 20-min call early next week.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is time-sensitive for our demo day on the 18th.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Growth, NovaHub
elena@novahub.co

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novahub.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator onboarding bundle and credit structure

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on cohort week. Short answer: we can provide a temporary bridge while you tune prompts and batching, but I need to confirm the amount with my manager.

Options I'm prepared to propose:
- One-time top-up credit (applied to your account) up to $2.5k while we monitor usage, OR
- A tiered promotional discount: 30% off invoices for the first 30 days up to $5k cap.

My ask: can you share a quick screenshot of the usage spikes (or a rough token count) so I can justify the exception? I can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow 10–10:30am PT if that works.

If we go with the credit top-up, we'll generate a short SOW amendment and route it through procurement. I'll loop in Marissa and Priyom to coordinate approval and billing.

— Logan
Logan Wright | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: NovaHub credit ask — recommended approach

Quick internal note:

Summary: NovaHub overshot accelerator credit (they received $20k promo). They estimate 35–40k usage month 1. Demo day pressure — high urgency.

Recommendation (fast path):
1) Approve a one-time $2,500 account credit to bridge to next invoice.
2) Offer an alternate option on the table to the customer: 30% off month-1 usage up to $5k if they prefer discount vs. credit.
3) Require the customer to sign a 1-page SOW amendment (billing/credit terms) and provide evidence of accelerator participation (certificate).

Rationale: keeps spend predictable, capped downside, fast turnaround for procurement. If Logan needs a larger exception (> $2.5k) escalate to Sales Ops (cc: me).

I'll standby for the usage screenshot — Priyom, please prepare an amendment template I can sign off on.

Marissa
Director, Startup GTM | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novahub.co>, Diego Alvarez <cfo@novahub.co>, Alex Chen <alex.legal@novahub.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Novahub — one-time top-up proposal (SOW attached)

Hi Elena / Diego / Alex — per our threads below, we discussed two short-term options. Marissa approved a fast-path one-time credit. Please see the proposal below and a short SOW attached to formalize: Novahub_TopUp_SOW_v1.pdf (attachment).

Proposal (choose one):
A) One-time account credit: $2,500 credit applied to your account immediately. No upfront payment required; credit applied to next invoice.
B) Promotional discount: 30% off billable usage for the first 30 days post-activation, capped at $5,000 (requires standard invoicing).

Terms we need to capture in the SOW:
- Credit is one-time and non-transferable.
- Applies to usage billed in the next 60 days.
- Customer must confirm accelerator participation (PDF certificate).
- This exception is a one-time promotional accommodation and not precedence for future cohorts.

Logistics: if you accept option A we can apply the credit immediately and update your billing account. If option B, we'll apply the discount on the first invoice after the 30-day promo window. Alex — for PO/invoice timing, please advise if you need a revised quote or a purchase order reference.

If helpful, I'm available Wed 9–10am PT to sign and route the SOW.

Thanks,
— Logan

Attachments:
- Novahub_TopUp_SOW_v1.pdf (attachment stub — 2 pages)

From: Elena Morales <elena@novahub.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Alvarez <cfo@novahub.co>, Alex Chen <alex.legal@novahub.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novahub — one-time top-up proposal (SOW attached)

Logan — thanks, we appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed internally and will take Option A (one-time $2,500 credit). A couple of quick clarifications:

1) Can the credit be applied before our invoice posts? We're trying to avoid any short-term cash flow friction with the accelerator sponsor.
2) The accelerator requires a letter confirming the amended credit for audit — can you attach a short confirmation email or updated SOW page we can share?

I've attached our accelerator participation certificate (accelerator_certificate.pdf) to this reply. If you can confirm application timeline and share the updated SOW page, we'll sign and route PO.

Appreciate the help — demo day is Monday and getting this in place would be a big relief.

Best,
Elena

Attachments:
- accelerator_certificate.pdf (attachment stub — 1 page)
